test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which organization/institute received the Subhas Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar for year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat Institute of Disaster Management**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 23 January 2022, marked the 125th birth anniversary of freedom fighter Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.
 
• The day will also be celebrated as ‘Parakram Diwas’ from 2022 onwards.
 
• PM Modi conferred the Subhas Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskars, for the years 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022.
 
• The award carries a cash prize of Rs 51 lakh for an institution and Rs 5 lakh for an individual.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• For the award this year, nominations were solicited from 1st July, 2021 onwards.
 
• In response to the award scheme, 243 valid nominations were received from institutions and individuals.
 
• For the year 2022, the following have been selected for the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar for their excellent work in Disaster Management:
 
 
• Gujarat Institute of Disaster Management (in the Institutional category)
 
• Professor Vinod Sharma (in the Individual category).
